reaction: The new branch makes the blood-supply step clearer.

reason: The clot-clearing enzymes are pictured cutting protein threads, and the clot contains a reinforcing protein mesh.

effect: The temporary clot was mostly cleared, leaving a closed surface, a small scar, supporting fibres and connected capillaries. All goals are complete.
reaction: It was useful to see that a scar remains and can keep changing after the surface closes.

mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the surface and then restoring blood flow was most worthwhile: it showed that the wound can look closed while deeper repair is still needed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting fibres and then placing them felt a little repetitive, although the separate steps showed where they came from and where they went.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the surface closed before the blood-supply step was complete, and that the clot was cleared afterward.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the placements understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: seeing the same wound change from an open gap into repaired skin made me curious about what else the game could connect.
